lines.text: Darkness falls over Snowfield Hot Spring.
we have gathered to uncover the secret behind the legend which states "■■■ roams in the dormitory".
If you're so easily scared, why did you all agree to meet at night?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: It's pretty obvious this legend has serious horror overtones, don't you think?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: but we've all been living in the dorms these past few days.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Has anyone seen anything out of the ordinary during our time here?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Noir and I haven't seen anything.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I got up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and I saw a strange silhouette!
Do you know anything about this, Ludmilla?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It's just that I also saw something strange a few nights ago.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I had just looked around the Snowfield and gotten back to the dorm,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: when I heard a strange sound coming from an empty room.
Lumi?! You scared the beejezus out of us...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Where did you come from, anyway?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Are you also interested in this story?
So, what was inside the room?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I know for a fact that I heard something, yet there was no one there.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If there had been someone inside, I at least would have known what the source of the noise was.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: But as soon as I opened the door, the sound stopped.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: This place was related to the legend.
You don't look like you're scared at all.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Anyway, I take it you're proposing that we all go looking around the dormitory

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: to find out what's behind these strange happenings?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: It could be dangerous, though, so stick close to us, Servant.
Stay close to Blanc and Noir.
I scootch up beside Blanc and Noir, who both appear scared out of their wits.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Thanks for walking with us, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I feel a lot better already.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Did you come to protect me?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Or are you tagging along because I don't look as scared as the others?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Either way, I'm always glad to have you as company.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: You don't get scared easy, do you?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: You're just the person I need right now.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll stick close to you then.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: You must not scare easily, Servant.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm planning on taking the lead.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Are you sure you'll be okay?
All of us form a tight formation and start to explore the dormitory.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Blanc, it's pitch black in here...

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'll protect you no matter what happens.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I'll do the same for you, too.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Wh-what was that sound just now?
I think those were the floorboards creaking.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: If you're scared that easily, you might as well turn back now.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I'll be fine so long as Noir and Pit Boss are here.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Besides, I wanna know what you and Mica saw.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I accidently banged into a shelf.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you're scared, Mica, you can hold my hand.
Just to make sure... you're saying you are scared?
Communication with Lumi is as strenuous as ever.
I wonder why she is so interested in all this?
Also, why did she show up so suddenly in the first place?
As I wonder about this and many other things,
Ludmilla, who's walking in front, halts in her tracks.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: This is the room where I heard the strange sounds.
At the very end of the hall, there is a room.
For whatever reason, it is situated far from all the other rooms.
Ludmilla slowly wraps her hand around the doorknob,
then rapidly twists it and flings the door open.
A chilling air wafts into the hallway the moment the door is opened.
It doesn't look like there's anything here.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Maybe Ludmilla and I were just imagining things?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I think whatever it is just can't be spotted so easily.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: There must be something we're missing.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Maybe it doesn't show itself when there are a lot of people around.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: does that mean one of us has to be left here alone?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I don't like this one bit...
... and waltzes straight into the room.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It looks like Lumi has something that she wants to do.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Let's stay back and watch for now.
She then raises her head and stares at the ceiling.
She fixates her gaze intently on something, as if she's found something she was searching for.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Lumi, what are you looking at?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Is there something on the ceiling?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Is there something inside the light fixture?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I'm getting major goosebumps. I'm freaking out.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Sorry, everyone, but Noir isn't doing so well.
and head back the way we came.
The bloodcurdling screams echoing throughout the building keep us from going any further.
I frantically turn back toward the room,
and see Lumi collapsed on the ground, trembling. Ludmilla and Emma rush over to her,
and in front of them, I see a faint apparition.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Or am I just seeing things?
Lumi frantically attempts to push Ludmilla and Emma away.
Ludmilla smacks Lumi on the back of the head,
the faint apparition in front of Lumi vanishes.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I think she might be in shock,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: which is why she reacted so violently.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That apparition we saw is gone.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It was kinda freaky seeing Lumi act like that,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: but since Old-Timer was here, I was able to calm myself.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yeah, a bit surprised, but okay.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We need to put Lumi to bed.
As all of us glance at Lumi's limp body,
we all silently reach the same conclusion:
whatever "■■■" is in the legend, is what we're dealing with.
Some kind of female spirit is roaming around the building,
one which appears to have a connection of some kind with Lumi.
For safety reasons, we decide to completely seal the innermost room.
No one is to approach it.
It's always so full of chatter, which pleases my ears,
but when she is alone, she likes to be silent.
That was the room my sister used.
Barely any sunlight enters this room.
We almost never get any visitors anyway.
Any room here would be as quiet as the next.
Why does she insist on using that room?
Many times I would ask her,
and the answer was always the same.
It's nice and cool in that room, and quiet.
You know how I sweat a lot.
As long as my sister is happy, then I'm happy too.
my sisters and I will have a great time.
